Real Estate & Personal Property Tax Statements are mailed out in December
and are due upon receipt.
​
The 1st half becomes delinquent on May 1st.
The 2nd half becomes delinquent on September 1st.
(If April 30th or August 31st is on a weekend or holiday,
the pay without interest date is extended to the next business day)
14% interest will be added to all delinquent taxes .
Please keep the top portion of the statement for your records and
send the appropriate stub with your payment.
Please include a self-addressed stamped envelope if
you would like a return receipt.
The Treasurer's office is not responsible for lost or missing statements.
Please contact the Treasurer's office at 308-262-1177
to request ​ total amounts for any delinquent taxes.

600 L Street

Bridgeport, NE 69336
Hours: 7:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Monday - Thursday
(open during noon hour)
and 7:30 a.m. to 11:00 a.m. on Fridays
Please note: vehicle titles will not be processed beginning
30 minutes prior to closing time.
​Phone: 308-262-1177
Fax: 308-262-1231
Email: treasurer@morrillcountyne.gov
​​DUTIES:
​​*To collect all revenues for the county
*To bill and collect all real estate and personal taxes in the county
*Register all motor vehicles with tax situs in the county including motorcycles, boats, and ATV's
*To disburse collections to the proper political subdivisions
*To issue drivers licenses, C.D.L's, learner permits, I.D. cards, school permits, etc.
